findings.claim: CSX 10-K：主要鐵路對手為 Norfolk Southern；2025 年 NS 與 Union Pacific 簽約合併，成為唯一跨大陸鐵路網，待 STB 核准。
findings.excerpt: CSXT’s primary rail competitor is Norfolk Southern Railway, which operates throughout much of the Company’s territory. During 2025, Norfolk Southern Railway entered into an agreement to merge with Union Pacific Railroad to form the nation's only transcontinental rail network, which requires the approval of the Surface Transportation Board.

findings.claim: CSX 風險因子：競爭來自其他鐵路與卡車；產業整併可能實質影響監管與競爭環境。
findings.excerpt: Additionally, any currently proposed or other future consolidation in the rail industry could materially affect the regulatory and competitive environment in which the Company operates.

findings.claim: BNSF 與 CSX 於 2025 年 8 月宣布新聯運服務，目標從長途卡車搶貨。
